survey: A crystal ball on a gold stand, standing on a wooden shelf in front of a green diamond-patterned wall. The camera is a little above the stand and slightly to the left, looking down a small amount. The shelf top is seen from above and its front face is visible, and its edges run roughly level with a gentle consistent slope. The stand's round base is a wide ellipse that sits flat on the shelf top. Its stepped neck and the cup rim above it are ellipses that get slightly narrower as they rise toward eye level, which is correct. The sphere is drawn as a true circle and sits down into the cup, with the cup's top face seen from above. Two curved prongs with ball tips rise from the cup rim to hold the sphere. The left prong starts at the left end of the rim and runs along the sphere's left outline. The right prong starts on the front-right of the rim, so it overlaps the sphere well inside its outline. This reads as a three-prong holder turned slightly, with the third prong hidden behind the sphere, so it fits one viewpoint. The shadow falls to the right across the shelf top, in the same plane as the base. Every part agrees on one camera.
